[CHANGELOG\.md:224](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/6c04f10076a79c7c62446151cb6304bbdf0b9332/CHANGELOG.md#L224) · T-030

CHANGELOG\.md describes a new Open Sales Program\. Referrers earn 5% of referred consumers' collected token spend as withdrawable earnings funded by Darkbloom\. Settlement is atomic per request, attribution is immutable, and uncertain settlements are retried\. This adds a self\-service reward\-minting path into A\-009, the payment ledger, and a new payout path for TB\-008\. The threat model has no threat for referral\-code registration, self\-referral or colluding accounts, duplicate or replayed settlement during retry and shutdown reconciliation, or exclusion of owner\-routed spend\. Only the changelog was visible here, so I could not verify the code\. Add a threat entry covering these abuse cases \(sybil or self\-referral, settlement idempotency, Privy\-session enforcement on mutations, owner and self\-route exclusions\)\. Add a concurrency and idempotency test for the retry path before relying on the stated mitigations\.
